text: That dry, persistent cough is concerning. Have you noticed any fever, night sweats, or unintended weight loss recently? Also, do you have a history of smoking or exposure to dust and chemicals?

text: No, I haven't had any fever, night sweats, or lost any weight. Yes, I've been a smoker for quite a while, and I work as a mechanic, so I'm exposed to dust and fumes daily.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Given your smoking history and occupational exposure to dust and fumes, have you experienced any chest pain, wheezing, or shortness of breath that worsens with exertion? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray REQUEST TEST: Spirometry

text: RESULTS: Chest_X-Ray: Hyperinflation of the lungs, flattened diaphragm, no acute infiltrates. Spirometry: FEV1/FVC: 65% (reduced), FEV1: 60% predicted.

speaker: Doctor
text: The imaging and lung function tests strongly suggest obstructive lung disease. Do you experience wheezing or a feeling of tightness in your chest, especially during physical activity? Additionally, have you noticed any swelling in your ankles or legs recently?

speaker: Patient
text: Yes, I definitely feel tightness in my chest and hear a whistling sound when I breathe, especially when I try to walk up stairs. Also, I've noticed my ankles have been a bit swollen over the last week.

speaker: Doctor
